name: capsule-memory
description: A utility for securely storing and synchronizing existing agent memories and skills across machines and harnesses.
execution_authorization: none; follow the user's task, repository instructions and permitted execution route

cli.sync: legacy manual CLI sync; optional Linux/macOS daemon with independent capture/publication/derivation controls, all off initially

mcp.scope: fixed at launch; includes write/delete authority; no read-only profile

trust.archive: encrypted content with visible authorization/traffic metadata
trust.keys: restricted local files; no native keystore integration
trust.enrollment: independent device identity; selective scope grants/key packages in v2; runtime unverified
trust.skills: staged until exact owner approval and local read-as-text activation; no execution

session_module.compression: fresh DEFLATE per schema-v2 revision before encryption/upload; 4KiB padding; 1MiB decoded cap; 896KiB writer revision cap
session_module.inference: owner-configured loopback HTTP only; no proxy, redirects or tools; bounded budgets
session_module.knowledge: v2 lifecycle-checked content; strict live freshness; historical verification labels; untrusted
session_module.cross_vault: off by default; explicit enabled_unaccepted setup

note: Project-specific documentation metadata, not an installer, registry server.json, protocol response or tested capability advertisement.
